summary: The bare mark, no wordmark — what Header uses.
useWhen: a wordmark is already visible nearby, or the bar is too narrow for the lockup
a favicon-scale identity marker inside the product

useInstead.when: this is the only place the product names itself
useInstead.why: a mark alone identifies nothing to someone who has not learned it yet

requires: `label` when the mark stands alone — it is the only thing naming it
notes: Omit `label` when a visible wordmark sits beside it; that text already carries the name.

antiPatterns.why: the name of the brand is the useful announcement; the word "logo" is not
